title.zh: 【美国财政部制裁 A7 网络，称其与 Nobitex 有关联并利用 A7A5 代币规避制裁】
title.en: 【美国财政部制裁 A7 网络，称其与 Nobitex 有关联并利用 A7A5 代币规避制裁】

current_state.zh: The U.S. Treasury's OFAC sanctioned the Russia-linked A7 shadow banking network for processing over $17 billion in illicit flows and using the ruble-backed A7A5 token to help Iran, Nobitex and North Korean hackers evade sanctions.
current_state.en: The U.S. Treasury's OFAC sanctioned the Russia-linked A7 shadow banking network for processing over $17 billion in illicit flows and using the ruble-backed A7A5 token to help Iran, Nobitex and North Korean hackers evade sanctions.
